# Max Bustamante

> CTO & Shopify Tech Lead at Digitdeck (Medellín, Colombia). 20+ Shopify storefronts, a production app suite, and the delivery system behind them. Open for Shopify CRO consulting.

The portfolio is served in three visual themes with the same content. Plató (`/plato`) is the canonical one; `/digitdeck` and `/ingenieria` point to it with `rel=canonical`. Pages are available in English, Spanish and Japanese.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://www.maxfolio.dev/plato): positioning, featured work and how a store review works
- [Work](https://www.maxfolio.dev/plato/obra): the Shopify storefronts and products, each with real desktop and mobile captures
- [Career](https://www.maxfolio.dev/plato/trayectoria): roles and timeline
- [Contact](https://www.maxfolio.dev/plato/contacto): book a call on Max's calendar or send a message
